text:
julia: noticed a steady stream of mTLS handshakes failing in ap-northeast-1 after midnight deploy
matt: logs show TLS alert 48 and KMS returned `InvalidCiphertext` when unwrapping ephemeral key
anika: which deploy touched aliases/keys? I rolled cert-manager + helm chart update at 00:02 UTC
julia: helm patch changed cert-controller to rotate key alias globally; looks like it pointed `alias/proxy` at eu-central key ARN for ap-northeast pods
pager-bot: paging oncall: incident triggered (handshake failures)
sre-oncall: impact: ~60 failed handshakes over 10m, some client retries bumped latency; rollback in progress
matt: quick mitigation: revert alias to region-local key via `aws kms update-alias --region ap-northeast-1 --alias-name alias/proxy --target-key-id <apn-key-id>`
anika: did that at 00:12 UTC, handshakes dropped to normal in ~35s
audit-bot: audit: mtls_event sampling is at 2% for proxies; important fields `kms_key_id` and `tls_principal` are redacted by default
julia: triage trouble: redaction + low sampling slowed root cause ID. For incidents we need unredacted trail in secure store
anika: propose: on rollback create secure-audit bundle with unredacted mtls_events for window [-1h,+1h] and send to secure S3 bucket with kms-envelope and 90d retention
sre-oncall: agree. Also: add a deploy-time guard in CI preventing global alias assignments unless PR includes region-explicit mapping and unit tests
matt: action items: (1) add CI lint blocking alias target ARNs that differ from chart region variable (2) add mtls canary job per region that performs end-to-end ACME sign + KMS decrypt test before promoting chart (3) temporary increase mtls_event sampling to 25% in ap-northeast and eu-central for 8h
julia: write RBAC checklist: before removing `kms:Decrypt` from any `proxy-*` role, run `aws iam simulate-principal-policy` and `kubectl auth can-i` to enumerate dependent services; require mtls-canary signoff
anika: I'll draft canary terraform & helm job: `mtls-rotation-canary` that rotates alias to staging key and runs `openssl s_client` against proxy to validate unwrap path
audit-bot: recommended evidence to store: helm release diff, aws cloudtrail KMS events, proxy logs, k8s events, aliased key ARNs, CI run for PR, and secure-audit bundle
sre-oncall: scheduling 45m postmortem at 08:30 UTC; owners @julia @anika @matt
julia: adding follow-ups to ticket INC-2026-0512 and will upload artifacts once secure bundle created
anika: thanks, will also add a region-guard lint rule in repo and a short playbook step: verify `aws kms describe-key --key-id` region equals expected before update
matt: also consider KMS key policy condition: `StringEquals": {"kms:CallerAccount": "111122223333", "kms:ViaService": "ec2.amazonaws.com" }` and encryption-context check for `region` where applicable
julia: ok closing this thread after artefacts linked :thumbsup:
